scope_basis: Account named Computer System Support: IT support that serves the department's systems and its desktop users alike, and the volume does not separate the two (treated as a ministry IT function under the scope rule of 2026-09-25).
doc_locator: Expenditure Estimates 2026/27 (final draft), recurrent estimates, Organisation 3400, Department 3403 'Department of Arts', parent account 00400, account 00428 'Computer System Support', column Estimate 2026-27 (PDF p. 549)
notes: Baseline is proposed: the 2026/27 estimates volume is the final draft tabled with the Appropriation (2026/2027) Bill No. 1 of 2026, and no enacted Act is held; the Bill's schedule equals the volume's recurrent organisation totals for all 30 organisations and its Development Fund sum (23,375,815,203) equals the volume's development total. Cross-foot: the account sums with its siblings to the printed parent-account total and department total, to the pula in the estimate and authorised columns. Funding source unstated: the recurrent half is the Consolidated Fund and prints no financing column.
